name: feature-flags
title: Feature flags
description: Feature flags in MongoDB: kill switches, deterministic gradual rollouts, per user and per role targeting, weighted variants, ctx.flags in code, route gates, an admin API, a frontend endpoint and a devtools panel.
docs:
In code: ctx.flags.enabled('new-checkout'), ctx.flags.variant('pricing-page'). Outside requests: await ctx.app.ext.flags.isEnabled(key, { user }).
Gate a route: import { requireFlag } from '#app/blocks/feature-flags/index.js' and set policy: [requireFlag('beta'), 'authenticated'] (404 while the flag is off for the caller).
Admin API: GET|POST /api/admin/flags, GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/admin/flags/:key. Frontends: GET /api/flags (clientVisible flags, send X-Anonymous-Id for visitors).
Declare the flags your code needs in calm.config.js: blocks: { 'feature-flags': { flags: { 'new-checkout': { description: '...', rollout: 0 } } } }.
